gloss: freely, at ease, in a relaxed manner

definitions.gloss: freely, at ease, in a carefree manner
definitions.explanation: Describes a state of being relaxed and unrestricted, able to grow or act without pressure or constraint. Often used about children growing up or people feeling at ease.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{伸|の}び{伸|の}び⟦{育|そだ}てたい→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: I want to raise children in a relaxed, free environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{伸|の}び{伸|の}び⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm living a carefree life in the countryside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ず、{伸|の}び{伸|の}び⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{過|す}ごしたい→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: On my days off, I want to relax and spend time without thinking about anything.

notes:
{伸|の}び{伸|の}び describes a state free from stress or restriction. Often used with the particle ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {伸|の}び{伸|の}び⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧ / ⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to grow up / raise freely
- {伸|の}び{伸|の}び⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧: to live in a relaxed way
- {伸|の}び{伸|の}び⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: to spend time in a carefree way
- {伸|の}び{伸|の}び⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧〜: relaxed, easygoing ~

USAGE: Has a strongly positive connotation. Suggests a healthy, natural state unburdened by excessive rules or pressure.
